name: Andrew Stetsenko
blurb: Has helped thousands relocate since 2012. Each week hand-curates ~100 verified tech jobs with visa/relocation support and personally contacts recruiters to confirm sponsorship. Paid tier = private 1,000+ job board, resume/LinkedIn reviews, live Q&As with recruiters.

name: Arbeitnow
blurb: Specialized board for English-speaking roles in Germany/EU with explicit visa sponsorship, relocation and salary info. Strong for India→Germany moves. Filter directly for 'Visa Sponsorship'.

name: The Stack Jobs
blurb: Lists tech companies across London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Dublin actively offering visa sponsorship + relocation. Filter by location, remote and sponsorship status.

name: Lenny Rachitsky
blurb: The most influential PM newsletter. His job board specializes in product-building roles (PM, Growth, Eng, Design, Data) at top startups — higher signal than LinkedIn. Great for warm, high-quality roles.

name: Exponent
blurb: Weekly curated PM/eng roles from top tech companies, plus the best-known PM interview prep (system design, behavioral). Useful both to find roles and to prep — which is your stated goal.

name: Remote PM Jobs
blurb: Pulls remote PM roles straight from company ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby), synced daily, no ghost jobs. Has dedicated 'Europe' and 'International remote' filters — handy for remote founding roles.

name: Ken Norton
blurb: Ex-Google Ventures PM partner. Weekly digest of PM advice + exclusive startup jobs you won't find elsewhere. Strong senior/leadership PM roles.

name: Mind the Product
blurb: Large international PM community with a job board, meetups and conferences worldwide — excellent for networking your way into European product roles.

name: Product Manager HQ
blurb: One of the biggest PM Slack communities with a robust job board ($25 lifetime). Good for referrals and roles shared peer-to-peer.

name: Dr. Nancy Li
blurb: Runs one of the largest PM coaching platforms; specializes in helping people (incl. from India) land PM jobs in the US. Portfolio-building, interview prep, referrals, mentors from FAANG. Free training on YouTube to vet her first.

name: Priyanka (Wanderess Priyanka)
org: IT Product Manager in Germany · 390k followers
blurb: PM at a German automotive company; built a big audience guiding Indians to move to Europe. Offers European-format CV, LinkedIn review, offer/visa-process guidance and a Germany/Europe career bootcamp via Topmate.

name: Coach Sandeep Khaira
blurb: Structured 15–30 week programs explicitly targeting visa-sponsor companies (lists PM as a supported track). Includes CV/LinkedIn, EU companies list, interview + salary-negotiation coaching. Transparent INR pricing.

name: PrimePathway
blurb: 'We run your job search' — branding, applications, recruiter connects, interview prep across US/UK/EU + remote-first roles. You show up for interviews. Vet their track record before committing.

name: Dhi ADT
blurb: Recognised visa sponsor in the Netherlands with India→NL/DE/UK relocation ops: IND filing, Blue Card, UK Skilled Worker, housing, registration. Most India→NL moves done in 6–10 weeks. Employer-funded, not candidate-paid.

name: Talcom Relocation
blurb: NL agency handling visas, housing and settlement for international tech hires. Good route into the Amsterdam ecosystem.

name: Transparent Hiring
blurb: Sources, relocates and integrates global talent into German companies; typically start within ~6 weeks of signing. Software & Product focus.

name: Europe Careers
org: Germany EU Blue Card / Skilled Worker
blurb: Helps experienced professionals secure direct German employment + Blue Card; rebuilds profile to German standards, targets employers in their network, handles the visa filing. (Charges for service — vet first.)

name: Fachkraft Ausland
blurb: Places vetted internationals with German employers and walks you through jobs, visa (Blue Card/Chancenkarte), bureaucracy and relocation. States zero hidden fees for candidates.
